supporting_observations.claim: Near the alerted time, the workstation's IP connected to DC-RB-01 over LDAP; the DC-side Sysmon record attributes its network activity to LSASS. These records do not identify a dump write or the process that would have created one.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied collection status reports a winsec and Sysmon collection outage on WS-CPRICE-01 from 13:30 to 14:15 UTC, covering the alert time. The status information has no record ID.
Proxy, Zeek connection, and DNS telemetry are reported available, but those sources do not establish which local process wrote a dump file.
claims_not_established: The supplied event records do not independently establish the dump's exact write time, path, size, hash, or contents.
The supplied event records do not identify whether vcdump.exe ran, whether another process created the dump, or whether the reported dump was a legitimate VetChart crash dump.
The available evidence does not establish whether the dump contained sensitive data or was accessed or exfiltrated.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain endpoint process-creation and file-write telemetry for WS-CPRICE-01 covering 13:30–14:15 UTC, including the dump's creator, path, and timestamp.
Collect the dump file's metadata and hash, and analyze its contents under appropriate handling procedures.
Verify whether C:\Program Files\VetChart\Tools\vcdump.exe was run and correlate any execution with the open VetChart hang ticket and authorized collection activity.
unrelated_findings: Separate triage only: cole.price ran WMIC to query locally running services, followed by host-originated SMB activity to DC-RB-01 using the workstation machine account. The records do not establish remote administration or a connection to the alerted dump. (S26-00027, S26-00028, S26-00035, S26-00036, S26-00038, S26-00039)
